_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Western Sahara (disputed territory) covering Saharan rock art, Sanhaja Berber nomads, Almoravid movement origin, trans-Saharan trade, Spanish Sahara colonisation, phosphate discovery, Green March 1975, Polisario Front, SADR (Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic), Moroccan Wall/Berm, UN MINURSO, and ongoing sovereignty dispute.

country_profile.capital: El Aaiún (Laayoune) (de facto, Moroccan-administered) / Tifariti (SADR declared capital)
country_profile.government_type: Disputed territory (majority administered by Morocco; Polisario/SADR controls eastern strip)
country_profile.currency: Moroccan dirham (MAD) in Moroccan-controlled zone / Sahrawi peseta (nominal, SADR)

gdp.source: No separate data; phosphate and fishing are main industries

ethnic_groups.name: Sahrawi (Hassaniya Arab-Berber)
ethnic_groups.notes: Indigenous population; Hassaniya Arabic-speaking; Sanhaja Berber and Arab heritage; Beidane (Moor) culture; nomadic/pastoral traditions; tribal confederations: Reguibat, Ouled Delim, Tekna, Izarguien, Arosien

ethnic_groups.name: Reguibat
ethnic_groups.notes: Largest Sahrawi tribal confederation; warrior-scholars; control vast territory; Polisario leadership heavily Reguibat

ethnic_groups.name: Tekna
ethnic_groups.notes: Southern Morocco/northern Western Sahara; straddle border; some pro-Morocco, some Polisario

ethnic_groups.name: Ouled Delim
ethnic_groups.notes: Historically dominant warrior tribe; Dakhla area; camel herders

ethnic_groups.name: Moroccan settlers
ethnic_groups.notes: Post-1975 settlers incentivised by Moroccan government; now significant population in cities; change demographic balance

independence.from: Spain withdrew 1976; sovereignty contested between Morocco and Polisario/SADR
independence.notes: SADR declared 1976-02-27; Morocco controls ~80% behind Berm; UN lists as Non-Self-Governing Territory; ceasefire 1991; no referendum held

country_profile.notes_unique: Africa's last colonial question; MINURSO is the only UN peacekeeping mission without a human rights mandate; Bou Craa has world's largest phosphate conveyor belt

current_leader_morocco.name: King Mohammed VI (through appointed Wali)
current_leader_morocco.title: Sovereign of administered territory
current_leader_morocco.notes: Morocco considers Western Sahara its 'Southern Provinces'; administers ~80% of territory

current_leader_sadr.name: Brahim Ghali
current_leader_sadr.title: President of SADR / Secretary-General of Polisario Front
current_leader_sadr.notes: Polisario Front; based in Tindouf refugee camps (Algeria); SADR recognised by ~40 states and AU

former_sadr_presidents.name: El-Ouali Mustapha Sayed
former_sadr_presidents.notes: Founder of Polisario; first SADR president; killed in battle at Nouakchott raid June 1976

former_sadr_presidents.name: Mohamed Abdelaziz
former_sadr_presidents.notes: SADR president for 40 years; led Polisario through war and ceasefire; died in office May 2016
